description_expanded: Welcome to Destiny by the Sea, a beautiful, private gated community located in Destin, FL! Here, you’ll find the perfect retreat with generous porches, an inviting floor plan, and a community pool, perfect for cooling off on those warm, sunny days so prevalent along the Emerald Coast. Just steps from the beach and near dining, shopping, and attractions, you’ll find plenty to do and all day to do it! Destiny by the Sea is a gorgeous Spanish villa-style home with five bedrooms and five baths accommodating up to twelve. Designed with impeccable taste and luxurious materials, beautiful furnishings invite you in to experience the ultimate in luxury living. You’ll find three bedrooms and a lovely morning kitchen on the first floor. Two bedrooms feature queen-sized beds, while a third houses two twin bunks, a great spot the kids will love. The sweeping wrought iron staircase, an architectural delight, connects all three floors, the second floor featuring spacious and bright rooms that seamlessly connect indoor and outdoor spaces. Catch gorgeous sunsets with family and friends on the massive private balcony with plenty of room for everyone to spread out. Prepare delightful meals or snacks for the pool in the fully appointed gourmet kitchen filled with upgraded appliances and a breakfast bar with seating for four. Two king-size master suites with king-sized beds and a private balcony await on the third floor guaranteeing everyone a good night’s sleep. You’ll also find a washer and dryer for added convenience. Hang out at the community pool or venture to the sugar-white shores for a stroll along the Gulf of Mexico. Spend the day shopping at The Silver Sands Outlet Stores, just ten minutes away. With over 100 shops and an array of restaurants to choose from, you’ll find something for everyone! Parties, events, bachelor and bachelorette parties are strictly prohibited, and an adult chaperone must accompany guests under 25 throughout their stay. Smoking is strictly forbidden, and pets are unfortunately not welcome and subject to immediate departure if found to be inhabiting a property. Guests found in violation are subject to eviction with no refund. Parking is available for 2 vehicles in the driveway, the garage is off limits to guests.
